title: How a Secret U.S. Cyberweapon Backfired

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: DealBook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域一些最具影响力的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不会想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, a group of online criminals has held the city of Baltimore's computer system hostage for nearly a month, paralyzing basic government functions.
sentences.zh: 今天，一群网络罪犯将巴尔的摩市的计算机系统劫持了近一个月，导致基本的政府职能陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: The software used to shut the system down was developed by a government agency just a few miles away.
sentences.zh: 用于关闭该系统的软件是由几英里外的一个政府机构开发的。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, June 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月4日，星期二。

sentences.en: So the National Security Agency was founded in 1952.
sentences.zh: 美国国家安全局成立于1952年。

sentences.en: There were earlier eavesdropping agencies, but that was sort of the post-World War II creation of one big agency to do all kinds of electronic intercepts.
sentences.zh: 之前也有过窃听机构，但这可以说是二战后建立的一个大型机构，专门负责各种电子截获。

sentences.en: Any way that foreigners of interest communicate, NSA tries to get there and collect.
sentences.zh: 无论是外国利益相关者通过何种方式沟通，国安局都会设法介入并进行收集。

sentences.en: Scott Sheen covers national security for The Times.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·希恩负责《纽约时报》的国家安全报道。

sentences.en: And in perhaps the last 20 years, they have created a hacking team that would break into foreign computer networks and collect intelligence.
sentences.zh: 在过去的20年里，他们建立了一支黑客团队，能够闯入外国计算机网络并收集情报。

sentences.en: And that sort of sets the backdrop to what's happening today.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是今天所发生事情的背景。

sentences.en: The way NSA breaks into foreign computer networks is it first hunts for vulnerabilities, as they're called, in commonly used software.
sentences.zh: 国安局闯入外国计算机网络的方式是，首先在常用软件中寻找所谓的漏洞。

sentences.en: And very often, these vulnerabilities are in windows.
sentences.zh: 非常常见的是，这些漏洞存在于Windows系统中。

sentences.en: It's extremely widely used around the world, including by governments, by foreign governments, which are often the target.
sentences.zh: 它在全球范围内被极其广泛地使用，包括被政府和外国政府使用，而外国政府往往是攻击目标。

sentences.en: But it's used by terrorist groups, foreign diplomats, foreign militaries.
sentences.zh: 但恐怖组织、外国外交官和外国军队也在使用它。

sentences.en: Even terrorists use windows.
sentences.zh: 甚至恐怖分子也在使用Windows。

sentences.en: Even terrorists use windows.
sentences.zh: 甚至恐怖分子也在使用Windows。

sentences.en: When NSA discovers a vulnerability these days, it goes to a sort of committee overseen by the White House, representing a bunch of different agencies.
sentences.zh: 如今，当国安局发现漏洞时，它会提交给一个由白宫监督、代表多个不同机构的委员会进行评估。

sentences.en: And there's a debate that takes place over whether NSA should be allowed to keep the
sentences.zh: 随后会引发一场辩论，讨论是否应该允许国安局保留该

sentences.en: vulnerability secret or should really report it to the software maker so that they can come up with a patch and make their software more secure.
sentences.zh: 漏洞的秘密，还是应该将其报告给软件制造商，以便他们能够推出补丁并提高软件的安全性。

sentences.en: So they found a particular vulnerability probably eight or nine years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在八九年前发现了一个特定的漏洞。

sentences.en: And they gave the vulnerability the name Eternal Blue.
sentences.zh: 他们给这个漏洞取名为“永恒之蓝”（Eternal Blue）。

sentences.en: And when the NSA discovers Eternal Blue, do they decide to tell Microsoft about it, about this vulnerability in their own software?
sentences.zh: 当国安局发现“永恒之蓝”时，他们是否决定将这个漏洞以及他们自己软件中的这个问题告诉微软？

sentences.en: No, they don't.
sentences.zh: 不，他们没有。

sentences.en: If they told Microsoft, Microsoft would put out, you know, one of those Windows updates.
sentences.zh: 如果他们告诉了微软，微软就会发布你知道的那种Windows更新。

sentences.en: So they would have put out a patch for Eternal Blue and essentially covered over this security hole in Windows.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们本会为“永恒之蓝”发布一个补丁，从根本上填补Windows中的这个安全漏洞。

sentences.en: So they didn't tell Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 所以他们没有告诉微软。

sentences.en: And so Eternal Blue became actually one of NSA's go-to tools for collecting intelligence.
sentences.zh: 因此，“永恒之蓝”实际上成了国安局收集情报的得力工具之一。

sentences.en: You know, they could kind of crawl in the upstairs window and rubbish around and take what they wanted.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们可以像从楼上的窗户爬进去一样，到处翻找并拿走他们想要的东西。

sentences.en: And no one was the wiser.
sentences.zh: 而且神不知鬼不觉。

sentences.en: Because this is all secret, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 因为这一切都是秘密，我们并不知道。

sentences.en: But it's certainly conceivable that somebody in Al Qaeda or ISIS was using
sentences.zh: 但完全可以想象，基地组织或伊斯国（ISIS）的某个人在某台机器上使用了

sentences.en: Windows on a machine, that NSA broke into one of those machines and learned something crucial about a forthcoming attack, for example.
sentences.zh: Windows，而国安局闯入了其中一台机器，并了解了有关即将发生的袭击的关键信息。

sentences.en: You know, we don't know, I'm just speculating here, but we were told that this tool was extremely effective in espionage and counterterrorism.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们并不清楚，我在这里只是猜测，但我们被告知该工具在间谍活动和反恐方面极其有效。

sentences.en: So the NSA keeps Eternal Blue a secret for at least five years until 2016, when something dire and shocking occurs.
sentences.zh: 因此，国安局对“永恒之蓝”保密了至少五年，直到2016年发生了可怕且令人震惊的事情。

sentences.en: A group calling itself the Shadow Brokers that's never been heard of before suddenly pops up on the web.
sentences.zh: 一个自称“影子经纪人”（Shadow Brokers）、从未听说过的组织突然在网络上出现。

sentences.en: And they announce that they have a lot of NSA's hacking tools, which are, of course, extremely secret, extremely carefully protected.
sentences.zh: 他们宣布拥有大量国安局的黑客工具，这些工具当然极其机密且受到严密保护。

sentences.en: And they are now going to auction them off online.
sentences.zh: 他们现在准备在网上拍卖这些工具。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: They make this announcement in a kind of strange, broken English.
sentences.zh: 他们用一种奇怪、生硬的英语发表了这则声明。

sentences.en: Attention, government sponsors of cyber warfare and those who profit from it.
sentences.zh: 注意，网络战的政府赞助商以及从中获利的人。

sentences.en: How much you pay for enemies' cyber weapons.
sentences.zh: 你们为敌人的网络武器支付了多少钱。

sentences.en: You enjoy.
sentences.zh: 你们很享受。

sentences.en: You break many things.
sentences.zh: 你们破坏了许多东西。

sentences.en: You find many intrusions.
sentences.zh: 你们发现了许多入侵。

sentences.en: You write many words.
sentences.zh: 你们写了许多话。

sentences.en: But not all.
sentences.zh: 但并非全部。

sentences.en: We are auctioned the best files.
sentences.zh: 我们正在拍卖最好的文件。

sentences.en: So there's this sort of strange, in-your-face aspect of this, that not only have we stolen
sentences.zh: 因此，这里有一种奇怪的、挑衅的意味，不仅我们在这里窃取了

sentences.en: the crown jewels here, but we're sort of having fun with them and trying to make a little money.
sentences.zh: 皇冠上的明珠，而且我们还在拿它们寻开心，并试图赚点小钱。

sentences.en: And does this auction work?
sentences.zh: 这场拍卖成功了吗？

sentences.en: Are people bidding on it?
sentences.zh: 有人在出价吗？

sentences.en: The auction is not going so well.
sentences.zh: 拍卖进展得并不顺利。

sentences.en: Not surprisingly, perhaps, purchasers seem wary of this situation.
sentences.zh: 也许并不令人意外，买家似乎对这种形势保持警惕。

sentences.en: You don't really want to tick off NSA.
sentences.zh: 你其实不想惹恼国安局。

sentences.en: So they don't appear to get a lot of purchasers of these cyber tools.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们似乎并没有为这些网络工具吸引到很多买家。

sentences.en: And at one point they say, the shadow brokers is trying auction.
sentences.zh: 在某个时候，他们说，影子经纪人正在尝试拍卖。

sentences.en: People's no like.
sentences.zh: 人们不喜欢。

sentences.en: The shadow brokers is trying crowdfunding.
sentences.zh: 影子经纪人正在尝试众筹。

sentences.en: People's is no liking.
sentences.zh: 人们不喜欢。

sentences.en: Now the shadow brokers is trying direct sales.
sentences.zh: 现在影子经纪人正在尝试直接销售。

sentences.en: So they're sort of telling the story of their startup business.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有点像在讲述他们创业公司的故事。

sentences.en: And things aren't going so well.
sentences.zh: 事情进展得并不顺利。

sentences.en: So in April of 2017, presumably frustrated that they're not going to make a lot of money off this, they just dump all these hacking tools onto the internet.
sentences.zh: 因此，在2017年4月，大概是因为对无法从中赚取巨额资金感到沮丧，他们直接将所有这些黑客工具倾倒到了互联网上。

sentences.en: The New York Times reports a massive security breach has shaken the National Security Agency to its core.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，一起大规模的安全漏洞事件震撼了美国国家安全局的核心。

sentences.en: A group calling themselves shadow brokers posted two major files online.
sentences.zh: 一个自称“影子经纪人”的组织在网上发布了两份主要文件。

sentences.en: One is a cybercrime free-for-all of tools and techniques the NSA has compiled to break past computer system firewalls.
sentences.zh: 一份是国安局为突破计算机系统防火墙而汇编的工具和技术的网络犯罪“大杂烩”。

sentences.en: The other is an advanced set of cyber weapons.
sentences.zh: 另一份是一套先进的网络武器。

sentences.en: Wow, they just give it away.
sentences.zh: 哇，他们就这样拱手让人了。

sentences.en: They give it away.
sentences.zh: 他们就这样送出去了。

sentences.en: It could be the National Security Agency's most significant leak of secrets since Edward Snowden blew the lid off the group surveillance tactics in 2013.
sentences.zh: 这可能是自2013年爱德华·斯诺登揭露该机构的监控战术以来，国家安全局最重大的一次机密泄露事件。

sentences.en: Kind of like WikiLeaks style.
sentences.zh: 有点像维基解密式的风格。

sentences.en: Except that this is not information.
sentences.zh: 只不过这不是信息。

sentences.en: It's very dangerous internet tools.
sentences.zh: 而是非常危险的互联网工具。

sentences.en: And one of the most significant of them is the one called Eternal Blue.
sentences.zh: 其中最重要的工具之一就是被称为“永恒之蓝”的工具。

sentences.en: Now, I should say that about a month before shadow brokers released all these tools, including Eternal Blue, NSA apparently contacted Microsoft
sentences.zh: 现在，我应该说，在大约在影子经纪人发布所有这些工具（包括“永恒之蓝”）的一个月前，国安局显然联系了微软

sentences.en: and said, geez, there's something you ought to know.
sentences.zh: 并说，天哪，有些事情你们应该知道。

sentences.en: And so thankfully, Microsoft is able to create a fix before it goes completely public through the shadow brokers.
sentences.zh: 因此，值得庆幸的是，微软在这些工具通过“影子经纪人”完全公开之前，能够创建一个修复程序。

sentences.en: But the problem is, and anyone knows this who uses Windows, you get that thing that says, you know, Windows updates are now available.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，任何使用Windows的人都知道这一点，你会收到一条提示，上面写着，Windows更新现已可用。

sentences.en: And some of them might even say critical Windows updates, security updates.
sentences.zh: 其中一些甚至可能会说关键的Windows更新、安全更新。

sentences.en: But you get busy with stuff, you got other things going on.
sentences.zh: 但你忙于手头的工作，还有其他事情要处理。

sentences.en: Or you minimize the box and drag it down to the corner and just kind of hope it goes away.
sentences.zh: 或者你将对话框最小化并将其拖到角落，只是希望它消失。

sentences.en: And you say, yeah, I'll do that next week.
sentences.zh: 然后你说，好吧，我下周再做。

sentences.en: And that even happens in large companies and institutions, in governments.
sentences.zh: 这种情况甚至发生在大公司、机构和政府中。

sentences.en: And so, you know, people kick this down the road.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，人们把这件事一拖再拖。

sentences.en: Many, many, many Windows, you know, computers around the world were protected.
sentences.zh: 全球非常、非常多的Windows计算机得到了保护。

sentences.en: People installed the patch, ran this update.
sentences.zh: 人们安装了补丁，运行了这个更新。

sentences.en: But many, many, many were not.
sentences.zh: 但也有非常、非常多的人没有这样做。

sentences.en: And sure enough.
sentences.zh: 果不其然。

sentences.en: A massive cyber attack now being described as unprecedented in its sheer size.
sentences.zh: 一场被称为规模空前的大规模网络攻击爆发了。

sentences.en: On a Friday in May of 2017.
sentences.zh: 在2017年5月的一个星期五。

sentences.en: Britain's National Health Service computers were the first to be hit Friday morning, forcing hospital emergency rooms to shut down, stopping surgeries.
sentences.zh: 英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的计算机在周五早晨首当其冲遭到攻击，迫使医院急诊室关闭，并停止了手术。

sentences.en: A computer is infected with something that comes to be known as WannaCry.
sentences.zh: 一台计算机感染了一种后来被称为“WannaCry”（想哭）的病毒。

sentences.en: This is a screenshot of what the virus dubbed WannaCry looked like.
sentences.zh: 这是被称为“WannaCry”的病毒的屏幕截图。

sentences.en: Hackers exploited this weak point to infect Windows computers with ransomware through spam email or attachments.
sentences.zh: 黑客利用这个薄弱点，通过垃圾邮件或附件用勒索软件感染了Windows计算机。

sentences.en: The ransomware...
sentences.zh: 勒索软件……

sentences.en: Your computer screen suddenly goes blank.
sentences.zh: 你的电脑屏幕突然变黑了。

sentences.en: And there's a message on the screen.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上出现了一条消息。

sentences.en: And it says, you have to pay X amount, or we will destroy your files.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，你必须支付一定金额，否则我们将销毁你的文件。

sentences.en: And within a day, it spreads to computers in 150 countries.
sentences.zh: 在一天之内，它蔓延到了150个国家的计算机。

sentences.en: A massive cyber attack has crippled computers, grounded airlines, and pretty much halted shipping around the world.
sentences.zh: 一场大规模的网络攻击导致计算机瘫痪、航班停飞，并几乎使全球航运停顿。

sentences.en: It affected all types of industries, from the FedEx Corporation in the U.S., to the Russian Interior Ministry,
sentences.zh: 它影响了各类行业，从美国的联邦快递公司（FedEx）到俄罗斯内政部，

sentences.en: to the French carmaker Renault, to British hospitals and medical centers.
sentences.zh: 再到法国汽车制造商雷诺以及英国的医院和医疗中心。

sentences.en: Pharmaceutical giant Merck tweeted that its computer network was compromised and people couldn't even get in the building.
sentences.zh: 制药巨头默克公司（Merck）在推特上发文称，其计算机网络遭到入侵，人们甚至无法进入大楼。

sentences.en: They were sent home.
sentences.zh: 他们被遣散回家了。

sentences.en: Turns out, behind this attack was North Korean intelligence.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这次攻击的幕后黑手是朝鲜情报机构。

sentences.en: And one of the main tools that they were using was Eternal Blue.
sentences.zh: 他们使用的主要工具之一就是“永恒之蓝”。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: Then later in 2017...
sentences.zh: 随后在2017年晚些时候……

sentences.en: Yet another massive cyber attack hit organizations across the developed world today.
sentences.zh: 今天，又一场大规模网络攻击袭击了发达世界的各个组织。

sentences.en: The attack involved malware known as Petya, locking victims' computers and asking them to pay a Bitcoin ransom of $300.
sentences.zh: 此次攻击涉及名为Petya的恶意软件，它锁定了受害者的计算机，并要求他们支付300美元的比特币勒索赎金。

sentences.en: There are corporations that report hundreds of millions of dollars of damages.
sentences.zh: 有企业报告称损失高达数亿美元。

sentences.en: The disruption spread to several companies, including Merck, WPP, and Rosneft.
sentences.zh: 混乱蔓延到了多家公司，包括默克、WPP和俄罗斯石油公司（Rosneft）。

sentences.en: That one is traced to Russian intelligence.
sentences.zh: 那次攻击被追溯到俄罗斯情报机构。

sentences.en: And that one, too, is using Eternal Blue.
sentences.zh: 那次攻击同样使用了“永恒之蓝”。

sentences.en: So how did all of these countries and victims deal with this attack?
sentences.zh: 那么，所有这些国家和受害者是如何应对这次攻击的呢？

sentences.en: Did they pay the ransoms?
sentences.zh: 他们支付赎金了吗？

sentences.en: You know, we don't know for sure.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们并不确定。

sentences.en: I've been told by people who do, you know,
sentences.zh: 从事网络安全咨询工作的人告诉我，

sentences.en: cybersecurity consulting that it's very common if a ransomware attack occurs against a company and it is not public knowledge for the company to make a payment in hopes of unlocking their files and making the whole thing go away.
sentences.zh: 如果一家公司遭到勒索软件攻击且此事并未公开，那么该公司为了解锁文件并让整件事平息而支付一笔款项是非常普遍的做法。

sentences.en: And ultimately, the cost of repairing your system, replacing your files, setting up backups and so on,
sentences.zh: 归根结底，修复系统、更换文件、设置备份等的成本，

sentences.en: is usually much greater than the amount of money that's demanded by the attackers.
sentences.zh: 通常远远大于攻击者所要求的金额。

sentences.en: So in 2017, the story of Eternal Blue and the other stolen NSA hacking tools sort of faded from the news for the most part.
sentences.zh: 因此，在2017年，“永恒之蓝”和其他被盗国安局黑客工具的故事在很大程度上从新闻中淡出了。

sentences.en: FBI and NSA still had not found the shadow brokers.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局和国家安全局仍然没有找到“影子经纪人”。

sentences.en: But then the same tool began to turn up in American cities and finally right in NSA's own backyard.
sentences.zh: 但随后，同样的工具开始出现在美国的城市中，并最终出现在国安局自己的后院。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《纽约时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看时报订户每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载时报应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Okay, Scott, before we get into this recent attack in Baltimore, bring us up to speed on what's been happening there over the past few months.
sentences.zh: 好的，斯科特，在我们深入探讨巴尔的摩最近发生的这起攻击之前，先给我们介绍一下过去几个月那里一直在发生什么情况。

sentences.en: Well, I think it's fair to say that the last thing Baltimore needed in 2019 was a cyber attack.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为可以公平地说，巴尔的摩在2019年最不需要的就是网络攻击。

sentences.en: Now to the scandal rocking the city of Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 现在将目光转向震撼巴尔的摩市的丑闻。

sentences.en: FBI agents raiding the home and offices of Mayor Catherine Pugh.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局特工突袭了市长凯瑟琳·皮尤（Catherine Pugh）的家和办公室。

sentences.en: It had just undergone a pretty unusual corruption scandal.
sentences.zh: 它刚刚经历了一场相当罕见的腐败丑闻。

sentences.en: Folks, the political career of Catherine Pugh is over.
sentences.zh: 各位，凯瑟琳·普尤的政治生涯结束了。

sentences.en: Former Democratic Mayor Catherine Pugh was considered a reformer, but nobody saw the children's book kickback scandal coming.
sentences.zh: 前民主党籍市长凯瑟琳·普尤曾被视为改革派，但没人料到会爆发童书回扣丑闻。

sentences.en: The mayor, Catherine Pugh, had been writing a series of books about a character she called Healthy Holly.
sentences.zh: 市长凯瑟琳·普尤一直在写一系列关于一个她称为“健康霍莉”的角色的书。

sentences.en: In fairness, it was a pretty novel scam.
sentences.zh: 平心而论，这是一个相当新颖的骗局。

sentences.en: You see, the mayor decided to self-publish a series of children's books called Healthy Holly.
sentences.zh: 你看，这位市长决定自费出版一系列名为“健康霍莉”的儿童读物。

sentences.en: Nothing wrong there.
sentences.zh: 这倒没什么问题。

sentences.en: Granted, there were some quality control issues, like having one of the main characters' names misspelled along with the word vegetable.
sentences.zh: 当然，其中存在一些质量控制问题，比如其中一个主要角色的名字拼写错误，连“蔬菜”这个词也拼错了。

sentences.en: But hey, this wasn't a crime against grammar.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，这并非针对语法的犯罪。

sentences.en: These books weren't selling.
sentences.zh: 这些书根本卖不动。

sentences.en: She hadn't really found an audience for them.
sentences.zh: 她并没有真正为这些书找到受众。

sentences.en: Until she discovered that she could sell hundreds of thousands of dollars worth of them to nonprofit organizations that she had connections to,
sentences.zh: 直到她发现自己可以把价值数十万美元的书卖给她有联系的非营利组织，

sentences.en: notably a hospital system on whose board she served.
sentences.zh: 尤其是她曾担任董事会成员的一家医院系统。

sentences.en: In total, her business took in about $800,000 in sales.
sentences.zh: 总计下来，她的业务创造了大约80万美元的销售额。

sentences.en: I think the last Baltimore author who got a deal that good was the late Tom Clancy.
sentences.zh: 我想上一位拿到这么好合同的巴尔的摩作家，大概是已故的汤姆·克兰西吧。

sentences.en: It was unclear with what motive, unless they were trying to win influence with the mayor of Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚其动机何在，除非他们是想借此讨好巴尔的摩市长。

sentences.en: And I sincerely want to say that I apologize that I've done something to upset the people of Baltimore that I love, care about.
sentences.zh: 我真诚地想说，对于我做出让巴尔的摩人民（我深爱并关心的巴尔的摩人民）感到难过的事，我深表歉意。

sentences.en: This morning, Baltimore has a new mayor.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，巴尔的摩迎来了一位新市长。

sentences.en: Jack Young says his predecessor's resignation will only make the city stronger.
sentences.zh: 杰克·扬表示，前任市长的辞职只会让这座城市变得更强大。

sentences.en: The past few weeks have been painful and traumatizing for all of us.
sentences.zh: 过去几周对我们所有人来说都是痛苦且备受创伤的。

sentences.en: Like each of you, I am utterly heartbroken.
sentences.zh: 和你们每一个人一样，我感到无比心碎。

sentences.en: We're going to make sure that the city moves forward.
sentences.zh: 我们将确保这座城市继续向前迈进。

sentences.en: So we're going to keep this city moving and we're going to get things done.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要让这座城市保持运转，并且我们要把事情做好。

sentences.en: So tell me about this attack.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我讲讲这次攻击吧。

sentences.en: So on the morning of May 7th, city workers go to their offices as usual and in the Department of Public Works, people are beginning their day and suddenly on their screens,
sentences.zh: 所以在5月7日上午，市里的工作人员像往常一样去办公室上班，在公共工程部，人们开始了一天的工作，突然在他们的屏幕上，

sentences.en: whatever they're working on disappears and there's a message.
sentences.zh: 无论他们正在处理什么都会消失，并出现一条信息。

sentences.en: And it says, we've been watching you for days.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，我们已经观察你们好几天了。

sentences.en: We won't talk more.
sentences.zh: 我们不多废话。

sentences.en: All we know is money.
sentences.zh: 我们眼里只有钱。

sentences.en: Hurry up.
sentences.zh: 快点。

sentences.en: Tick-tack, tick-tack, tick-tack, tick-tack.
sentences.zh: 滴答，滴答，滴答，滴答。

sentences.en: Tick-tock?
sentences.zh: 滴答？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Presumably, this is not originating with a native speaker of English, but who knows?
sentences.zh: 据推测，这并非出自英语母语者之手，但谁知道呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: So this appears on computer screens all over the city.
sentences.zh: 于是，这出现在了全城各处的电脑屏幕上。

sentences.en: It spreads from the Department of Public Works across all of the departments of city government.
sentences.zh: 它从公共工程部蔓延到了市政府的各个部门。

sentences.en: And people suddenly don't have access to their computers.
sentences.zh: 人们突然无法使用他们的电脑了。

sentences.en: They don't have email.
sentences.zh: 他们无法收发电子邮件。

sentences.en: For a while, the phones stop working.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，电话也停止了工作。

sentences.en: And a lot of the functions of city government are paralyzed.
sentences.zh: 市政府的许多职能陷入了瘫痪。

sentences.en: The attack ground real estate transactions to a halt.
sentences.zh: 这次攻击导致房地产交易陷入停滞。

sentences.en: Prompting city employees to work 12-hour shifts in order to conduct all their day-to-day city business via phone and even in person.
sentences.zh: 促使市府员工不得不进行12小时轮班，以便通过电话甚至当面处理日常的市政业务。

sentences.en: Residents today still unable to pay water bills, tickets, taxes and close real estate deals online.
sentences.zh: 如今居民们仍然无法在线支付水费、罚单、税款以及完成房地产交易。

sentences.en: And folks are fed up.
sentences.zh: 而人们已经忍无可忍了。

sentences.en: A red light and a parking ticket.
sentences.zh: 一个红灯和一张停车罚单。

sentences.en: Now I have to come tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 现在我得明天来。

sentences.en: And if it's not working tomorrow, then I have to come day after tomorrow also.
sentences.zh: 如果明天还不行，那我后天也得来。

sentences.en: My car was stolen.
sentences.zh: 我的车被偷了。

sentences.en: I need to pay the ticket so they can release my car.
sentences.zh: 我需要交罚单，好让他们把车放了。

sentences.en: There were health alerts that didn't go out about disease outbreaks and bad batches of drugs.
sentences.zh: 有些关于疾病暴发和劣质药品的健康预警未能及时发出。

sentences.en: It's kind of pouring molasses into the works of city government.
sentences.zh: 这就像是往市政府运作的齿轮里倒糖浆。

sentences.en: Whoever's responsible is demanding 13 bitcoins or some $100,000 to unlock the system.
sentences.zh: 幕后黑手索要13个比特币，折合大约10万美元来解锁系统。

sentences.en: In this case, targeting a very vulnerable target, a U.S.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们瞄准了一个非常脆弱的目标，一个美国

sentences.en: city.
sentences.zh: 城市。

sentences.en: Scott, I'm just curious.
sentences.zh: 斯科特，我很好奇。

sentences.en: Why would whoever did this target a city and a kind of medium city without a ton of money at that?
sentences.zh: 为什么做这事的人会把目标对准一个城市，而且还是一个并没有多少钱的中等城市？

sentences.en: Not a billion-dollar corporation that would probably not think much of paying off this ransom.
sentences.zh: 而不是那种可能根本不会把支付这笔赎金放在心上的数十亿美元大公司。

sentences.en: What exactly is the idea of this target?
sentences.zh: 攻击这个目标的真正意图究竟是什么？

sentences.en: So, you know, sophisticated operations, big companies and so on updated their software, patched their systems back in March of 2017.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，成熟的运营机构、大公司等在2017年3月就已经更新了软件、给系统打了补丁。

sentences.en: And so there's a dwindling number of Windows computers that are vulnerable to an attack that uses Eternal Blue.
sentences.zh: 因此，容易受到利用“永恒之蓝”攻击的Windows电脑数量正在不断减少。

sentences.en: And now, more recently, in the last year or so, there's been quite a few attacks on American cities.
sentences.zh: 而在最近的一年左右，针对美国城市的攻击相当频繁。

sentences.en: Local governments, without a lot of spare money, often without a lot of sophistication about IT and Internet security, they provide a lot of services to the public.
sentences.zh: 地方政府没有太多闲置资金，通常也缺乏IT和互联网安全方面的专业知识，但它们却要为公众提供大量服务。

sentences.en: So, presumably, the criminals are thinking, as they attack local governments, there will be a lot of pressure to get these systems up and running again.
sentences.zh: 所以，据推测，罪犯们在攻击地方政府时认为，恢复这些系统会带来巨大的压力。

sentences.en: So maybe we can squeeze a ransom payment out of these guys and their systems aren't patched.
sentences.zh: 因此，也许我们可以从这些家伙身上榨取一笔赎金，而且他们的系统还没打补丁。

sentences.en: And give me a sense of what is significant specifically about Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 能跟我讲讲巴尔的摩的具体特殊之处在哪里吗？

sentences.en: Well, if you think about Eternal Blue, born years ago at Fort Meade, Maryland, on the NSA campus, well, that's about a 15-minute drive from Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你想想“永恒之蓝”，它多年前诞生于马里兰州米德堡的NSA（国家安全局）园区，嗯，离巴尔的摩大约有15分钟的车程。

sentences.en: Lots of NSA employees.
sentences.zh: 有大量的NSA员工。

sentences.en: NSA has a huge workforce.
sentences.zh: NSA拥有庞大的员工队伍。

sentences.en: And lots of NSA employees live in the city of Baltimore and in its southern suburbs.
sentences.zh: 而且许多NSA员工都住在巴尔的摩市及其南部郊区。

sentences.en: So, essentially, Eternal Blue, you know, made its way around the world and then came home.
sentences.zh: 所以，从本质上讲，“永恒之蓝”转了一圈流落世界各地，然后又回到了老家。

sentences.en: What have you heard, Scott, from the NSA?
sentences.zh: 斯科特，你从NSA那里听说了什么？

sentences.en: Well, the NSA, whose name has sometimes been interpreted as never say anything or no such agency, has, true to form, said nothing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，NSA（其名字有时被调侃为“永远别说什么”或“查无此局”）一如既往，什么也没说。

sentences.en: The big picture here is that they've said nothing since the shadow brokers first popped up and said, we have a bunch of NSA tools in 2016.
sentences.zh: 宏观来看，自2016年“影子经纪人”首次浮出水面并声称“我们有一堆NSA的工具”以来，他们就一直保持沉默。

sentences.en: They really haven't been held publicly accountable for the loss of this big chunk of their arsenal.
sentences.zh: 对于这大批军火库的丢失，他们实际上并未承担任何公开责任。

sentences.en: And why is that exactly?
sentences.zh: 这到底是为什么呢？

sentences.en: My sense is that there are ways that Congress and lawmakers can hold NSA officials responsible in kind of closed-door ways that will not compromise national securities.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，国会和立法者可以通过某种闭门方式让NSA官员承担责任，而这不会危及国家安全。

sentences.en: Isn't that why we have these secure rooms in the basement of the Capitol?
sentences.zh: 国会大厦地下室里设那些安全保密室不就是为了这个吗？

sentences.en: There have been questions asked of NSA officials in closed hearings, but none of this has become public.
sentences.zh: 在闭门听证会上，有人向NSA官员提出了质问，但这些都没有公开。

sentences.en: And NSA correctly says that its entire cyber espionage program is classified and that it's actually illegal to talk about it in public.
sentences.zh: 而NSA正确地指出，其整个网络间谍项目都是机密，公开谈论它是非法的。

sentences.en: But I think in this instance, it's a situation in which at some point you kind of have to ask, is the NSA using classification, sort of official secrecy,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得在这个案例中，在某个时刻你不得不禁不住发问：NSA是不是在利用保密等级这种官方保密手段，

sentences.en: to avoid responsibility for what has really become a disastrous saga in the history of the agency?
sentences.zh: 来逃避对这一桩已经演变成该机构历史上灾难性事件的责任？

sentences.en: You know, these are, or can be very dangerous weapons.
sentences.zh: 要知道，这些是（或者说可能成为）非常危险的武器。

sentences.en: And if the NSA is unable to keep them safe, you know, it raises all kinds of questions about the costs and benefits of these operations.
sentences.zh: 如果NSA无法保证它们的绝对安全，你知道的，这就会引发关于这些行动代价与收益的各种问题。

sentences.en: And part of the problem here is that, at least as far as we've been able to determine,
sentences.zh: 而这里的部分问题在于，至少据我们目前所能确定的，

sentences.en: the FBI and NSA have to this day not determined who the shadow brokers are or how they obtain these hacking tools.
sentences.zh: FBI和NSA至今仍未查明“影子经纪人”究竟是谁，或是他们是如何获取这些黑客工具的。

sentences.en: We still don't know the answer to those questions, so we don't really know how negligent NSA was.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然不知道这些问题的答案，所以我们并不真正清楚NSA到底有多疏忽。

sentences.en: And therefore, we don't really know, you know, what the lessons are and whether they have been learned.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们其实也不知道有什么教训，以及这些教训是否已经被汲取。

sentences.en: So now it's been nearly a month since this attack in Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 所以现在距离巴尔的摩遭受这次攻击已经快一个月了。

sentences.en: Where is the city?
sentences.zh: 这座城市现在怎么样了？

sentences.en: What kind of shape is it in?
sentences.zh: 它处于什么状况？

sentences.en: Well, the new acting mayor, Jack Young, made the decision not to pay the ransom.
sentences.zh: 嗯，新的代理市长杰克·扬做出了不支付赎金的决定。

sentences.en: No, I will not pay a ransom to anybody.
sentences.zh: 不，我绝不会向任何人支付赎金。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: And the city hired a number of cybersecurity contractors to come in and assess the damage and try to figure out how to work their way out of it.
sentences.zh: 并且该市雇佣了一批网络安全承包商来评估损失，并设法找出摆脱困境的方法。

sentences.en: And I'm told that as of Wednesday of last week, city employees began to get their email back.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，截至上周三，市政府员工已经开始恢复收发电子邮件。

sentences.en: How much in the end do you think this will cost the city?
sentences.zh: 你认为最终这会给该市造成多大损失？

sentences.en: City budget officials at a hearing last week estimated the cost at more than $18 million.
sentences.zh: 市预算官员在上周的听证会上估计损失超过1,800万美元。

sentences.en: I think about $10 million in immediate recovery costs and about $8 million in fees that they didn't collect or collected late as a result of the shutdown.
sentences.zh: 我认为大约有1,000万美元是直接恢复成本，大约800万美元是因为系统关停而未能收取或迟收的费用。

sentences.en: So particularly compared with the ransom of $100,000, that's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 所以，特别是与10万美元的赎金相比，这是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: For a city like Baltimore, that is real money.
sentences.zh: 对于像巴尔的摩这样的城市来说，这可是真金白银。

sentences.en: And there's a particular irony and particular pain to Baltimore being attacked by tools made at NSA.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩遭到由NSA制造的工具攻击，这本身就具有一种特殊的讽刺意味和切肤之痛。

sentences.en: While we have had trying times recently, I'm confident we will prevail.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们最近经历了一段艰难的时期，但我相信我们一定会赢。

sentences.en: I would like to thank our fellow state partners for working closely with us as we work to fix a virus that has affected the city's network of computer service.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢我们的州级合作伙伴与我们密切合作，共同修复影响了该市计算机服务网络的病毒。

sentences.en: But the people of Baltimore, much like our great city, are made tough.
sentences.zh: 但巴尔的摩人民就像我们伟大的城市一样，骨子里透着顽强。

sentences.en: I don't know nobody else that's more resilient than Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 我不知道还有谁能比巴尔的摩人更具韧性。

sentences.en: Scott, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 斯科特，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: And as someone who lives in the Baltimore region, I wish you good luck.
sentences.zh: 作为一名住在巴尔的摩地区的人，我祝你好运。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Since we spoke with Scott, a Maryland congressman said he was informed by the NSA that Eternal Blue was not used in the ransomware attack on Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 在我们与斯科特交谈之后，一位马里兰州国会议员表示，他被NSA告知，“永恒之蓝”并未被用于针对巴尔的摩的勒索软件攻击。

sentences.en: In a story following up on that claim, Scott and fellow Times reporter Nicole Perloff stood by their reporting,
sentences.zh: 在后续报道中，斯科特和《泰晤士报》的同事妮可·佩洛夫坚持他们的报道，

sentences.en: writing that sources directly involved in the investigation told them that all four contractors hired to study what happened in Baltimore had discovered Eternal Blue.
sentences.zh: 他们写道，直接参与调查的消息人士告诉他们，受雇研究巴尔的摩事件的所有四家承包商都发现了“永恒之蓝”。

sentences.en: The NSA, however, has declined to publicly comment.
sentences.zh: 然而，NSA拒绝公开置评。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们去广告，马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: President Trump began a highly anticipated state visit to Britain on Monday with a series of tweets sent while still in the air,
sentences.zh: 美国总统特朗普周一开启了备受瞩目的英国国事访问，他在仍在飞机上时就发送了一系列推文，

sentences.en: insulting the mayor of London, whom the president called a, quote, stone-cold loser.
sentences.zh: 侮辱了伦敦市长，总统称其为“冷血失败者”。

sentences.en: The mayor, Sadiq Khan, appeared to provoke the president's anger by calling on British Prime Minister Theresa May to denounce Trump's policies and conduct ahead of the visit,
sentences.zh: 市长萨迪克·汗似乎激怒了总统，他在访问前夕呼吁英国首相特雷莎·梅谴责特朗普的政策和行为，

sentences.en: something May did not do.
sentences.zh: 而梅并未这样做。

sentences.en: After arriving in London, the president traveled to Buckingham Palace, where he met with Prince Charles and his wife Camilla, and with Queen Elizabeth.
sentences.zh: 抵达伦敦后，总统前往白金汉宫，在那里会见了查尔斯王子及其妻子卡米拉，以及伊丽莎白女王。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎进来了一批自称是改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党便陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人热血沸腾的权力争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和主持人萨拉·科尼格将为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却最终失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 您可以在各大播客平台上收听。
